description: The manual colour panel every picture clip carries: exposure, tone, balance, sharpness and edge.
name: Adjust

description: Greens pulled toward amber, the picture dipped in fall light.
name: Autumn

description: More low end.
name: Bass

description: The silver-retention film process: colour washed out, contrast pushed hard.
name: Bleach Bypass

description: A soft bloom over the highlights that breathes in and out.
name: Bloom Pulse

description: A cross-dissolve that blurs into the cut and sharpens back out of it.
name: Blur Dissolve

description: Air and presence: a lift above six kilohertz.
name: Bright

description: Sepia that keeps its contrast and its highlights, so it reads as old film rather than a brown wash.
name: Bronze

description: Stone and height: reflections that take a while to arrive.
name: Cathedral

description: Higher and squeakier.
name: Chipmunk

description: Keys out the screen colour you pick, leaving the picture over whatever is beneath, its spill cleaned off.
name: Chroma Key

description: Red and blue pulled apart towards the edges, the colour fringing of a cheap lens.
name: Chromatic Aberration

description: Muted highlights and deep, open shadows: the restrained look of a classic colour negative.
name: Classic Chrome

description: Barely there: neutral, a gentle curve, a touch more colour, and the reds calmed so a face reads even. What a talking head wants.
name: Clean

description: A hand sweeps around the centre, revealing the incoming shot as it turns.
name: Clock Wipe

description: Skies deeper and bluer, foliage cooler and calmer, the rest of the picture and every face untouched. Travel footage.
name: Cloudless Sky

description: Lift, gamma and gain: the shadows, midtones and highlights each pushed towards a hue and made brighter or darker.
name: Color Wheels

description: More or less contrast in stops about middle grey, highlights past white kept and black never crushed.
name: Contrast

description: Deeper shadows, brighter highlights.
name: Contrast Pop

description: Shifts the picture towards daylight shade.
name: Cool

description: Blue in the shadows and midtones, highlights and skin left neutral, contrast up. Cities at dusk.
name: Cool Blue

description: A cool blue-white corona gathered off the picture's blown highlights by a golden-angle spiral blur - built from nothing, not a port of the stock halation.
name: Corona

description: The outgoing shot rotates away like a cube face as the incoming one rotates into view.
name: Cube

description: The picture's levels bent along curves you draw: luma for brightness alone, then red, green and blue.
name: Curves

description: Magenta into the shadows, cyan into the light, pushed hard and neon-bright.
name: Cyberpunk

description: Soft cinema: blacks lifted, the light blooming warm, shadows a touch cool, skin kept. The look of a story told in a window seat.
name: Daydream

description: Lower and fuller.
name: Deep

description: Warm and saturated, the appetising push every food shot wants.
name: Delicious

description: Takes the hum and hiss out from under the voice.
name: Noise Reduction

description: The 2000s point-and-shoot: hard flash, whites blown, colour up, a cool cyan cast, over-sharpened with the sensor's noise.
name: Digicam

description: A soft cross-dissolve from one shot into the next.
name: Dissolve

description: Driven hard and clipped.
name: Distorted

description: A soft, hazy bloom over lifted pastel blacks.
name: Dreamy

description: One repeat, fading.
name: Echo

description: Clears the room out of a recording: rumble, hiss, sibilance and uneven level.
name: Enhance Voice

description: Brighter or darker by stops of light, as the lens would make it, highlights kept.
name: Exposure

description: The outgoing shot fades down to black, then the incoming one fades up out of it.
name: Fade to Black

description: The outgoing shot fades up to white, then the incoming one fades down out of it.
name: Fade to White

description: Faces brightened and evened: skin lifted, reds calmed, the balance neutral, the rest of the frame left where it was.
name: Fair

description: A warm fade with dust drifting down through it and a light leak in one corner. The CPU shows the fade and a whisper of noise.
name: Falling Dust

description: A film curve with a real toe and shoulder, warm halation around the lights, and grain that moves. Print stock, not a filter.
name: Film

description: A warm over-exposed flash burns through the cut.
name: Film Burn

description: Dancing grain, the texture of film stock.
name: Film Grain

description: The bulge of a very wide lens.
name: Fisheye

description: Daylight footage made to pop: midtones lifted, colour brought up where it is muted, a breath of mint in the brightest whites, skin left alone.
name: Fresh

description: A soft, even blur.
name: Gaussian Blur

description: Digital tearing and channel splitting rip through the cut.
name: Glitch

description: Chromatic slice tear and digital pixel displacement transition.
name: Glitch Warp

description: A soft bloom around the bright parts of the picture.
name: Glow

description: Late light: a warm balance that keeps its brightness, orange in the highlights, a whisper of magenta in the shadows, blacks lifted a touch.
name: Golden Hour

description: The red-orange halo film lays around its blown highlights, where light passes through the emulsion, scatters off the backing and comes back.
name: Halation

description: The picture reduced to a grid of black and white dots.
name: Halftone

description: A concert hall: long, even reflections.
name: Hall

description: Black and white pushed hard: deep blacks, bright whites, nothing in between.
name: High-Contrast Mono

description: A circle opens from the centre to reveal the incoming shot.
name: Iris

description: Milk's warm twin: the same soft matte with cream in the whites and a little gold in the middle. Interiors and morning light.
name: Ivory

description: Water and sky turned aquamarine and brightened, sand and skin left warm and clean. The beach-day look creators reach for first.
name: Lagoon

description: Greens and blues pushed richer, the punch a travel shot wants.
name: Vivid Landscape

description: Organic overexposed film burn flash bridging the cut.
name: Light Leak Flash

description: A warm streak of light sweeps across the cut.
name: Light Leak

description: A straight edge wipes the incoming shot across the outgoing one.
name: Linear Wipe

description: A small old speaker: no top end, and a grain to the sound.
name: Lo-fi

description: Brings the whole clip to one loudness, the way broadcast and the platforms expect.
name: Normalize Loudness

description: Keys out the dark of the picture - fire, smoke or sparks shot on black - or, inverted, the light.
name: Luma Key

description: Night city: the lights and signs made vivid and blooming, blacks kept deep and cool, faces left clean. Made for the strip.
name: Marquee

description: Soft green through the midtones and whites, colour muted, a light matte. The trend look, gentle enough for a face.
name: Matcha

description: Harsh, mid-focused projection from a handheld megaphone.
name: Megaphone

description: Deep blacks, a cool cast over everything but the lamps, colour low, a little grain. Late-night desk and monologue footage.
name: Midnight

description: Bright and matte: whites soft and cool, blacks lifted well off the floor, colour quiet. The clean minimal look of a white room.
name: Milk

description: Black and white through a coloured filter: red darkens skies and lightens skin, green does the reverse. A little grain if you want it.
name: Mono

description: Blacks crushed by a film toe, colour drained, bronze through the middle, cool in the shadows, the corners closing in.
name: Moody

description: A streak along a line, as if the camera panned.
name: Motion Blur

description: A gentle, true-to-life lift: barely-there warmth, skin left alone.
name: Natural

description: Magenta in the shadows, cyan in the highlights, hard contrast, colour turned up, and the lights themselves blooming. Night streets and signage.
name: Neon

description: Low light opened up: shadows lifted with the noise softened before it rises, whites held, the blue of the night kept.
name: Night

description: Desaturated and heavy, with a cold cast into the shadows and the corners dimmed.
name: Noir

description: Skin warmed toward peach and softened, shadows lifted so lines ease, contrast low. Portraits and talking heads; it is meant to run at half strength.
name: Peach

description: Low contrast, pink and lavender in the light, and a soft bloom over it all. The dreamy one.
name: Pink Fuzz

description: Up or down by semitones, the length untouched.
name: Pitch

description: Big square pixels.
name: Pixelate

description: A studio plate: dense, bright and short.
name: Plate

description: The instant print: a cream matte, warm highlights, cyan creeping into the shadows, a little softness in the corners.
name: Polaroid

description: Flat bands of colour, like a screen print.
name: Posterize

description: The incoming shot pushes the outgoing one off the frame.
name: Push

description: A small speaker on a long wave: narrow band, a little crunch.
name: Radio

description: Cool, hazy and drained, with the wet reflections lifted and blooming. Street-level walks at the end of the day.
name: Rain

description: A heavy warm fade with a yellowed, sun-bleached cast.
name: Retro 70s

description: Flat bands of colour with inked edges, like a printed comic.
name: Retro Cartoon

description: The colour channels pull apart through the cut and snap back together.
name: RGB Split

description: A metallic, modulated voice.
name: Robot

description: The early reflections of a room.
name: Room

description: A soft pink lift into the highlights, flattering and warm.
name: Rosy

description: Muted and green-teal through the midtones, a gentle film curve, warmth only where a face is. The quiet grade of an indie film.
name: Sage

description: Richer or greyer colour, about each pixel's own brightness.
name: Saturation

description: A cool, sterile steel-and-teal grade, saturation held back.
name: Sci-Fi

description: The incoming shot grows through a shape from the centre of the cut.
name: Shape Wipe

description: Crisper edges.
name: Sharpen

description: A cool, soft black and white with the shadows lifted, like a silver print.
name: Silver

description: The incoming shot slides in over the outgoing one, which holds still underneath.
name: Slide

description: A matte: blacks lifted, whites eased down, contrast low, and a soft bloom in the light with cream in it. Airy and flattering.
name: Soft Light

description: The outgoing shot spins away as the incoming one spins into place.
name: Spin

description: Drained colour, a green-cyan cast, a hard toe, and a heavy vignette. For the season.
name: Spooky

description: Vast stadium echoes and reverberations across a massive arena.
name: Stadium

description: Faded, warm and grainy: an old home movie run through a projector.
name: Super 8

description: A brighter, lighter, closer voice. Pitch at 0 follows the amount.
name: Sweet

description: The cut twists both pictures around its centre and untwists into the next shot.
name: Swirl

description: Teal in the shadows, orange in the highlights, skin held as skin, a film curve over it. The blockbuster grade, and the most requested look there is.
name: Teal & Orange

description: The narrow band of a phone line.
name: Telephone

description: More sparkle.
name: Treble

description: Saturated and bright, the water pushed teal.
name: Tropical

description: The café look: warm brown through the middle, greens muted to olive, contrast eased. Cosy, and kind to wood and skin alike.
name: Umber

description: Submerged beneath the surface with heavy low-pass filtering.
name: Underwater

description: Magenta and cyan pushed hard, a saturated retro-synth cast.
name: Vaporwave

description: Colour bleeding sideways, scan lines, softness, tape noise and too much saturation, with the slight vertical smear of a worn head.
name: VHS

description: Richer colour where it is muted, without blowing out what is already strong.
name: Vibrance

description: Darkened corners that draw the eye to the middle.
name: Vignette

description: A seventies print: matte blacks and whites, colour faded, greens gone to yellow, a soft vignette.
name: Vintage

description: Warm, vintage turntable character with band-limited sound.
name: Vinyl

description: Colour that sings and contrast that bites, with a little edge: the look that reads as a better camera. Skin is held back from the boost.
name: Vivid

description: Shifts the picture towards candlelight.
name: Warm

description: High-speed directional camera whip with motion blur.
name: Whip Pan

description: Airy, breathy tone with attenuated low end and enhanced presence.
name: Whisper

description: The picture as if lit warmer or cooler, and turned towards magenta or green, as the eye adapts to the light.
name: White Balance

description: Desaturated and blue, the blacks lifted to a matte wintry haze.
name: Winter Cool

description: A rush towards a point, as if the lens zoomed during the shot.
name: Zoom Blur

description: Rapid inward/outward camera rush with radial zoom blur.
name: Zoom Blur

description: A whip zoom out of the outgoing shot and into the incoming one.
name: Zoom
